thread:
nina: Quick sync 1: we have scattered uses of `model` vs `model_name` in SDK snippets and a few pages that say just "latency" when they mean end-to-end. Proposing: canonicalize public SDK examples to use `model`, reserve `model_name` for DB/schema docs, and use the phrase "response latency" for end-to-end measurements.

omar: +1 to `model` in examples. Shorter and matches our clients. Can do a tiny PR to update js/py snippets.

priya: Agreed. One doc note: avoid the word "deprecated" in snippet comments unless we have a formal deprecation plan. Use "legacy" instead for customer-facing examples.

nina: Good call. Also add a single-line glossary entry that states the rule and a short voice note: "Use concise, neutral phrasing; avoid promotional adjectives." Keep it prescriptive (start with "Use").

omar: I'll open a small PR updating snippets and add an examples/README blurb. Plan to include a compatibility comment like: `// legacy schemas may use model_name` rather than "deprecated".

priya: I'll review wording in Observability pages and replace ambiguous "latency" with "response latency" where appropriate.

docs-bot: New PR opened by omar: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/5012 - "examples: unify model param"

omar: Added a tiny docs-lint that flags mixed param names in examples to prevent regressions. Also added a changelog entry in docs/CHANGELOG.md.

priya: Quick nit: in the examples README please add a line mapping db field -> sdk param: "If your schemas use `model_name`, mapping to `model` in the SDK is acceptable."

nina: Perfect. Assigning reviews: @priya for content, @nina for tone. If both green I'll merge and post a short note in #release-notes.

priya: Reviewing now.

docs-bot: PR 5012 CI passed \u2705

omar: Updated comments to say "legacy" not "deprecated" and fixed one remaining mixed snippet. Ready for merge after priya approve.

priya: LGTM. Merging.

docs-bot: PR 5012 merged by omar at 2461005472

nina: Thanks all 1: added "verify SDK param naming parity across examples before merge" to the docs style checklist and filed a docs-tooling ticket to enforce it automatically. :rocket:
